items.summary: fix(ci): keep child runtime restart reason private (#175450) The reason added by #175206 has always been consumed within process-respawn. Remove its unused export while retaining the recent-restart loop check, graceful lifecycle request and independent admission reason unchanged. Validation: both process-respawn suites pass, 37 tests in 84.13s wall time. The dependency scan no longer reports this export. Production and full-tree unused-file scans pass; the MCP v1 peer fixtures are live compatibility proof and their audit ownership was already repaired in 801d701eb30b. P2 review found no actionable findings.

items.title: fix(google): keep runtime out of speech catalog discovery (#175455)
items.summary: fix(google): keep runtime out of speech catalog discovery (#175455) The network classifier added in 604f858653da imports channel retry policy and logging through retry-runtime. Google catalog construction reaches it through the shared speech helpers, tripping the intentional cold-catalog redaction trap rather than a Vitest hoisting error. Load the classifier inside the existing asynchronous synthesis operation and combine it with the Google-specific predicate there. Keep all catalog traps and speech assertions unchanged. Transient recovery, malformed-output request counts, credentials, response cleanup, and update behavior remain the same; no SDK or configuration change. Proof: the catalog regression fails on current main; the repaired catalog and Google speech suites pass all 42 cases with one worker. Full pnpm build, targeted Google typecheck, type-aware lint, formatting and P2 review pass.

items.title: fix(update): ignore permission-only drift in retained package trees (…
items.summary: fix(update): ignore permission-only drift in retained package trees (#175449) After a recursive setfacl (e.g. granting a second account read access to ~/.npm-global), files inside the updater's private retained package trees carried an ACL mask in their group bits, and recovery refused with 'Package publication object changed' even though identity and content matched; only 'openclaw update repair' recovered. Integrity verification of private retained trees now ignores group/other permission bits (content, type, identity, ownership, owner bits and symlink targets still must match; legacy full-mode receipts still need an exact digest match), and verified objects with widened bits are tightened back through the shared no-follow repair helper with one aggregated warning. No receipt format change. Fixes #170032
